transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm just here because... well, things have been happening for a few months now. It's hard to explain without sounding... I don't know. But I see the same pattern. My sister's appointments get moved around, bills keep showing up wrong. People suddenly forget to call me back. Everyone keeps telling me it's just mistakes or clerical errors, but... I know they're keeping information from me. They're trying to push me out of making decisions for her.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds when no one else was around?
No. ... I don't hear voices. I haven't experienced anything like that.
How has your mood been over these past few months?

My mood? ... It's fine. Just normal, I suppose. 

I mean, it's frustrating dealing with all these so-called mistakes, but... my mood hasn't changed. I'm fine.
Before these past few months, have you generally felt that other people could be trusted?
Yes... I suppose so. I've always just gone about my business. I never really had any reason to doubt people before. It's just... recently. That's all.
